title: Minimum Average of Smallest and Largest Elements
summary: Start with an empty array of averages.
statement: Start with an empty array of averages. Given an even-sized array of integers, repeatedly remove the smallest and largest elements, calculate their average, and add it to averages. After n/2 iterations, return the smallest value in the averages array.
constraints: Repeatedly remove the smallest and largest remaining elements and record their average.
hints: Sorting reveals the exact sequence of repeated minimum/maximum removals.
Pair the first with last, second with second-last, and so on.
Compute each pair’s average and retain the smallest.
Those symmetric sorted pairs are precisely the forced removal pairs, so their minimum is the requested result.
editorial: Those symmetric sorted pairs are precisely the forced removal pairs, so their minimum is the requested result.

tests.explanation: Sorted extreme pairs average to 8, 8.5, 6, and 5.5; the minimum is 5.5.
